## Rules

- SQL panel/exact subject identity + OR точных (tenant,context) пар, не независимые IN. Scalar ≤1 role_grants+1 permission_grants query. Identity HostKeyColumns/IdentityCodec, fields только GrantFields decisionValues; malformed id → SourceError. Роли разворачивает core. rolesOnly не читает permission_grants. Primary write PDO для state/grants, Default отдельный pinned read-only PDO route без sticky/write fallback, не Storage::table()/state() с useWritePdo; transaction/read mode guard только при consumed fenced source; весь fence на одном handle. Нынешний Storage::state использует table()->useWritePdo (Storage.php:83–85,143); P4.4 добавляет pinned Default helper и transaction guard: writePDO внутри old snapshot не fresh. T_before → capabilities → T_after: discard whole set/retry ≤3; PolicyOnly 0 assignment/state/dynamic reads. FiltersQueries contextsCovering возвращает raw witnesses tenant/type; Selection everywhere(contributions)/in(refs,contributions)/nowhere/contributions() по D15 §5, refs candidate superset, не Allow. Storage::own: own-+substr(hash(sha256, IdentityCodec::compose([resolved connection,prefix])),0,60), повтор пары hostKeys match, два prefix одного connection не коллизия. StoresGrants::transaction делегирует mutate, apply P5.2. Models validated. Arch allowlist D15 §7.

## Guidance

Raw grants/roleGrants тестируются с explicit exact AccessScope непосредственно, не через scoped Authorizer до P4.6. Engine binary keys/trailing spaces/>2038/fields/read mode/rolesOnly, state retries, selection multiple witnesses одной scope. Own reuse/hostKeys mismatch/same connection two prefixes. Scoped V74/V91/P08 — P4.18, dynamic V82/V92 — P4.17/P4.18, real race — P4.21.
